title: A beautiful space …
text:
The Royal Palace of Alcázar is the oldest royal palace in Europe - history and art intertwined since the 11th century displaying magnificent unique architectural styles together with tiles and tapestries which are truly stunning - look closely at the walls and soak in the intricate details hidden within. Gardens just beautiful and peaceful. Such incredibly good value for money - we wandered for 3 hours and could have stayed longer. 
Sadly, the cafe food is not at all good and drinks are poor (gift shop has closed down?)  - but this place is all about the palace. Worth getting tickets well in a

title: Lovely few hours mooching
text:
A lovely visit. Spent a couple of hours wandering the gardens and buildings which were lovely to cool down in such hot weather!  Stunning architecture. Handy little café, not extortionately priced. 
Don’t forget your ID/passports. Luckily I had a copy of ours in my camera roll.
